mapper.sql: S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS ATND_CRTR_ID , S.ORG_ID , O.ORGNM , O.ORGNM AS ORG_NM , O.ORG_SHRTNM , O.ORG_SHRTNM AS ORG_SHRT_NM , O.ORG_TYCD , NVL((SELECT MAX(CD.CDNM) FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD WHERE CD.UP_CD = 'ORG_TYCD' AND CD.CD = O.ORG_TYCD), O.ORG_TYCD) AS ORG_TYCDNM , O.CHRGRNM , O.CHRGRNM AS CHRG_PRSN_NM , S.DGRS_YR , S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , S.DGRS_YR AS HAKSA_YEAR , S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT AS HAKSA_TERM , S.SMSTR_CHRTNM , S.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS HAKSA_TERM_NM , S.RGTR_ID , S.REG_DTTM , S.MDFR_ID , S.MOD_DTTM , COUNT(C.CRTR_STNG_ID) AS CRTR_CNT
TO_NUMBER(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT, '^[0-9]+$') THEN S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT END)
CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT, '^[0-9]+$') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , DESC , S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT DESC
GROUP BY S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , S.ORG_ID , O.ORGNM , O.ORG_SHRTNM , O.ORG_TYCD , O.CHRGRNM , S.DGRS_YR , S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , S.SMSTR_CHRTNM , S.RGTR_ID , S.REG_DTTM , S.MDFR_ID , S.MOD_DTTM
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.DGRS_YR DESC, , O.ORGNM ASC) AS LINE_NO ,
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.listPaging 메뉴명 : 출석점수 기준관리 목록 조회 */

/* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.selectPrev 메뉴명 : 이전 기준 학기 조회 비고 : 선택한 기관/년도/학기보다 이전인 학기 중, 기준이 존재하는 가장 최근 학기를 조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT S JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON S.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDC_SCR_CRTR_STNG C ON C.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE NVL(O.USEYN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND S.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDC_SCR_CRTR_STNG C2 WHERE C2.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SB JOIN TB_LMS_BYWKNO_ATTNDNC_CRTR BW ON BW.SBJCT_ID = SB.SBJCT_ID WHERE SB.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND NVL(SB.USEYN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(SB.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' ) ) AND ( S.DGRS_YR < #{haksaYear} OR ( S.DGRS_YR = #{haksaYear} AND ( ( IS NOT NULL AND IS NOT NULL AND < ) OR ( ( IS NULL OR IS NULL) AND S.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT < #{haksaTerm} ) ) ) )
ORDER BY S.DGRS_YR DESC, ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1

/* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.listDtl 메뉴명 : 출석점수 기준비율 목록 조회 */ SELECT CRTR_STNG_ID , SMSTR_CHRT_ID , STNG_SEQNO AS CRTR_SEQ , STRT_AVG_PRGRT AS START_RATE , END_AVG_PRGRT AS END_RATE , ATNDC_SCR AS SCORE , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_ATNDC_SCR_CRTR_STNG WHERE SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} ORDER BY STNG_SEQNO ASC, STRT_AVG_PRGRT DESC

/* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.selectWeekCrtr 비고 : 학기기수 내 과목 기준 중 1건만 대표값으로 사용한다. 화면에서는 학기 공통값처럼 보이지만 저장 시에는 해당 학기 활성 과목 전체에 동일 기준을 반영한다. 메뉴명 : 출결기준 및 진도율 설정 조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BW.BYWKNO_ATTNDNC_CRTR_ID , BW.SBJCT_ID , BW.LRN_PRD_IN_PRGRT AS ATND_MIN_PRGRT , BW.LATE_RCG_PRD_IN_PRGRT AS LATE_MIN_PRGRT , BW.LATE_PRD_IN_PRGR_RCGRT AS LATE_RECG_RATE , BW.ABSNT_LATE_PRD_IN_PRGR_RCGRT AS ABSENT_RECG_RATE FROM TB_LMS_BYWKNO_ATTNDNC_CRTR BW JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SB ON SB.SBJCT_ID = BW.SBJCT_ID WHERE SB.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} AND NVL(SB.USEYN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(SB.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SB.SBJCT_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1

/* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.listSubject 메뉴명 : 학기기수별 과목 목록 조회 */ SELECT SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT WHERE SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} AND NVL(USEYN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(DELYN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SBJCT_ID
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : AtndCrtrDAO.deleteWeekCrtr 메뉴명 : 출결기준 및 진도율 설정 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_BYWKNO_ATTNDNC_CRTR WHERE SBJCT_ID IN ( SELECT SB.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SB WHERE SB.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} AND NVL(SB.USEYN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(SB.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' )
